note: The picture vocabulary (docs/contracts/images/README.md, Pictures are drawings). valid: the server accepts them, stores canonical (the canonical form, byte for byte) and a client draws them. invalid: the server refuses them; client says whether a client must refuse them too (active content: yes; a wrong namespace is only the server's business). theme: themeSvg(input) is output, byte for byte. Go: server/internal/images/contract_test.go; web: lib/api/images.dom.test.ts.

valid.name: an OpenMoji black outline
valid.svg: <svg id="emoji" viewBox="0 0 72 72" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="line"><path fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" d="M1 2h3"/><circle cx="1" cy="1" r="2"/></g></svg>
valid.canonical: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" id="emoji" viewBox="0 0 72 72"><g id="line"><path fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" d="M1 2h3"/><circle cx="1" cy="1" r="2"/></g></svg>

valid.name: an XML header, a gradient and a same-document reference

valid.name: title text is escaped, whitespace elsewhere and unquoted-looking text are dropped

invalid.name: an animation that sets a link
a comment that HTML ends at once (the stored XSS)
a style attribute with a CSS escape
an escaped url() in an attribute
an HTML element in the SVG namespace
nested use that multiplies
invalid.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="a"><use href="#b"/></g><g id="b"><use href="#a"/></g><use href="#a"/></svg>

invalid.name: a use of a use
invalid.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path id="p" d="M0 0"/><use id="u1" href="#p"/><use href="#u1"/></svg>

invalid.name: an href that is not a plain fragment
a use with a script: href

theme.name: black strokes and fills become currentColor, other colours stay
theme.input: <svg><path fill="none" stroke="#000" d="M0"/><path fill="#000000" d="M1"/><path fill="black"/><rect fill="#abda4d"/></svg>
theme.output: <svg><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" d="M0"/><path fill="currentColor" d="M1"/><path fill="currentColor"/><rect fill="#abda4d"/></svg>

theme.name: a colour that only starts like black is left alone
